title: Filipino-Style Tofu Casserole
description: A fusion of Asian flavors and Western casserole comfort food, featuring crispy tofu and aromatic spices.

ingredients.name: Filipino Seasoning Blend
ingredients.notes: containing garlic, onion, and bay leaves

instructions: Cut the tofu into 1-inch cubes and coat with Filipino seasoning blend.
Fry the tofu in vegetable oil until golden brown.
In a separate pan, sauté the onion, garlic, and bell pepper until softened.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Combine the cooked rice, fried tofu, and vegetable mixture in a baking dish.
Top with additional Filipino seasoning blend and Filipino-Style Hot Sauce (if using).
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped green onions or cilantro.
